article.headline: Dockery's 25 lead Howard past Morgan State 100-95
article.description: — Marcus Dockery's 25 points helped Howard defeat Morgan State 100-95 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Dockery's 25 lead Howard past Morgan State 100-95
article.story: WASHINGTON -- — Marcus Dockery's 25 points helped Howard defeat Morgan State 100-95 on Saturday night. Dockery shot 9 of 15 from the field, including 3 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 6 from the line for the Bison (7-9, 2-0 Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference). Blake Harper scored 23 points while going 7 of 12 and 8 of 11 from the free-throw line and added seven rebounds and six assists. Anwar Gill had 14 points and shot 6 of 8 from the field and 2 of 3 from the free-throw line. Will Thomas finished with 24 points and three steals for the Bears (7-12, 1-2). Kameron Hobbs added 24 points and two steals for Morgan State. Ahmarie Simpkins had 20 points, five assists and two blocks. NEXT UP Both teams next play Monday. Howard hosts Coppin State and Morgan State plays Norfolk State at home. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
